output.summary: A perennial shrub or subshrub native to South America, lemon verbena has glossy, pointed leaves that release a strong lemon scent when bruised. Its leaves flavour foods and drinks, including fish, poultry, jams and herbal tea, and are also used to flavour liqueurs.
output.edibilityNote: Leaves are used to flavour cooked dishes, marinades, dressings, jams, puddings, yogurt and beverages, and to make herbal tea and flavour liqueurs.
